specs.Item Type Name: Rechargeble Bluetooth Wireless Keyboard with Wireless mouse

features: 【⌨️ Silent & Precise X-Scissor Keys – 99-Key Full Layout】Work comfortably with 99-key full layout, featuring silent X-Scissor keys and 3 million-cycle durability. Designed for smooth, stable keystrokes and reliable everyday performance.

【🔗 Dual-Mode Connectivity – 2.4 GHz + Bluetooth】Switch instantly between devices using BT or 2.4 GHz wireless. Offers up to 10 m range and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (via USB dongle), making it ideal for multi-device workflows.

【🖱️ Optical Mouse with 3-Level DPI Control】The wireless optical mouse includes 800/1200/1600 DPI adjustable resolution, 3 main buttons, scroll wheel, DPI switch, and On-Off button. Lightweight at 69 g with battery for effortless control.

【🔋 Long-Lasting 500 mAh Rechargeable Battery – Both Devices】Keyboard and mouse each include a 3.7V 500 mAh lithium rechargeable battery, supporting long hours of use. Standard Type-C charging ensures faster, convenient, and cable-efficient recharges.

【🧩 Compact, Durable & Lightweight Design】Keyboard: 320 × 125 × 20 mm, lightweight 248 g with battery. Mouse: 110 × 60 × 40 mm, compact 69 g with battery. Made with durable ABS material for long-term reliability at home or office.
